name: yt-dlp
description: yt-dlp’s updater compares the selected artifact’s SHA-256 with its SHA2-256SUMS entry when available. It restricts automatic restart when checksum metadata is unavailable. This supports the checksum control, not independent authentication of the checksum manifest.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; release metadata may change.
A repository public.key exists, but this updater body does not use it.
